capabilities: Display built-in In plan and Today task views
Filter tasks with GUI filters and DQL queries
Create tasks and subtasks from the view
Arrange tabs, columns, groups, and sort order by drag-and-drop
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; requires Obsidian 1.8.0 or newer.
intentEvidence: adds a planning view and a today dashboard on top of TaskLite Core
problem: Obsidian task workflows lack a dedicated planning and today dashboard view for tasks managed by TaskLite Core.

relations.evidence: TaskTodo is an Obsidian plugin that adds a planning view and a today dashboard on top of TaskLite Core.

summary: Planning and today dashboard for TaskLite Core with built-in task views, filters, and drag-and-drop organization.
